simple.meaning: חֲשֵׁכָה (chăshêkâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “darkness ; figuratively, misery.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across Genesis, Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at Genesis 15:12. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲשֵׁכָה (H2825).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֲשֵׁכָה (chăshêkâh) / H2825 is traced through Genesis 15:12, Psalms 82:5, Psalms 139:12, Isaiah 8:22 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H2825. chashekah חֲשֵׁכָה noun feminine darkness (chiefly in poetry) — ׳ח Gen 15:12 2 t., so read also probably Micah 3:6 (for חָֽשְׁכָה ᵑ0 ); חֲשֵׁיכָה Psa 139:12 ; construct חֶשְׁכַּת 18:12 ; plural חֲשֵׁכִים Isa 50:10 ; — darkness , opposed to light ( אוֺרָה ) Psa 139:12 ; supernatural, ׳ח גדולה Gen 15:12 (JE); מַיִם חֶשְׁכַּתֿ Psa 18:12 in theoph. (but || 2Sam 22:12 חַשְׁרַתמֿים a mass of water ); figurative = lack of understanding Psa 82:5 ; = distress Isa 8:22 (|| צָרָה ), 50:10 .
definitions.rootNote: or חֲשֵׁיכָה xlit chăshêkâh corrected to chăshêykâh ; from 2821 ;

occurrences.englishText: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
They don’t know, neither do they understand.
even the darkness doesn’t hide from you,
and look to the earth, and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
